assessment: This study presents important insights on the impact of SARS-CoV-2 variants on the binding and neutralization of a small library of nanobodies. The authors should be applauded for their comprehensive in vitro and in silico analyses of nanobody targeting of SARS-CoV-2 variants. The evidence supporting the claims of the authors is now convincing. This work will be of great interest to researchers in the fields of antibody/nanobody engineering and SARS-CoV-2 therapeutics.
